statement: PFS MUST support four data classification levels.
PFS MUST preserve classification through transformations unless authorized declassification occurs.
PFS MUST control external data transfer.
PFS MUST define provider data handling profiles.

PFS MUST review external templates before trusted use.

PFS MUST enforce permissions independently of skill instructions.

PFS MUST support dependency version pinning for reproducible builds.
PFS MUST track license information where available and applicable.
PFS MUST control execution of external scripts.
PFS MUST support integrity verification for imported components.
PFS MUST support component revocation or quarantine.
PFS MUST preserve generation provenance.
PFS MUST define supply-chain incident response.
PFS MUST NOT treat hashes as proof of trustworthiness.
PFS MUST NOT assume that unlicensed assets are free to use.

PFS MUST identify affected artifacts when a trusted source is revoked.
PFS MUST enforce least privilege.

PFS MUST distinguish trusted instructions from untrusted content.

PFS MUST đánh giá lại tác động khi scope hoặc risk thay đổi.
PFS MUST NOT áp đặt technology stack của PFS lên generated projects.

PFS MUST NOT treat newer versions as automatically authoritative.

PFS MUST classify changes by impact.

PFS MUST support change impact analysis.

PFS MUST support migration planning and validation.
